simple.meaning: חֲבַר (chăbar) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an associate.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Daniel 2:13. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲבַר (H2269) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חֲבַר (chăbar) / H2269 is traced through Daniel 2:13, Daniel 2:17, Daniel 2:18 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.
Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
